subject.title: fix(cli): abort reaps autonomous executor process trees

question: Must explicit abort guarantee termination of autonomous executor descendants that create a separate POSIX session or process group?
rationale: The proposed implementation guarantees process-group cancellation, but accepting that scope versus requiring daemonized-child containment determines whether the credential-bearing survivor described by the linked incident is actually fixed.

options.title: Require full containment
options.body: Treat autonomous descendants as turn-owned after daemonization and require an appropriate containment design plus live proof before merge.

options.title: Limit the guarantee
options.body: Accept process-group-only cancellation and narrow the documentation to state that separately daemonized descendants are unsupported and may survive.

options.title: Pause this approach
options.body: Hold the change until a reliable cross-platform ownership mechanism is available if supported launchers can daemonize.

recommendation.title: Require full containment
recommendation.body: Treat autonomous descendants as turn-owned after daemonization and require an appropriate containment design plus live proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main history connects this person to both the service-managed spawn policy and the abort lifecycle contract.
